summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary OPC Energy Ltd. announced a bond offering of NIS 600 million (approximately $202 million) of Series E Bonds to be listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The offering consists of a preliminary institutional offering and a retail offering. Institutional orders were approximately NIS 1.33 billion (about $450 million). The final interest rate is undetermined, expected at no more than 4.56% annually. Completion is discretionary to OPC, subject to approvals including TASE. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. What to watch: bond pricing and demand in retail tranche.
